#!/usr/bin/env ruby

require 'optparse'

verbose = false
parser = OptionParser.new do |opts|
  opts.banner = 'Usage: wordcount.rb [--verbose] FILE'
  opts.on('--verbose', 'Also print the line count') { verbose = true }
end

begin
  parser.permute!(ARGV)
  abort parser.to_s unless ARGV.size == 1

  words = 0
  lines = 0
  File.foreach(ARGV.first) do |line|
    words += line.split.size
    lines += 1
  end

  puts "Words: #{words}"
  puts "Lines: #{lines}" if verbose
rescue OptionParser::ParseError, SystemCallError => e
  abort e.message
end
